display_information.name: Helpdesk Assistant
display_information.description: Answers questions about tickets and queues from live data, scoped to what the asker is allowed to see.
display_information.long_description:
An example Slack app manifest for an agent registered on this platform. Replace the names and descriptions with your own, then paste it into Slack's app-creation flow.

The agent signs in against your workspace so it can match a Slack user to a person, and every answer is checked server-side against that person's access before it is sent. It responds in channels when mentioned, and in direct messages for private questions.
